<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>☁️ Claudia 角色生成器</title>
    <script src="https://unpkg.com/docx@8.5.0/build/index.umd.js">
    </script>
    <style>
        :root {
            --bg: #faf7f0;
            --bg2: #f5f0e8;
            --card: #fdfbf6;
            --border: #e0d8c8;
            --border-light: #ece5d7;
            --text: #3d3830;
            --text2: #6b6358;
            --text3: #8a8278;
            --accent: #7b9eae;
            --accent2: #8aafc0;
            --accent3: #6b8e9e;
            --accent-light: #d8e8ef;
            --accent-bg: #eaf2f6;
            --danger: #c4887b;
            --danger-bg: #fdf0ed;
            --success: #7ba98e;
            --success-bg: #edf6f0;
            --paper: #fbf6ea;
            --paper-line: #d4cdb8;
            --shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(60, 50, 40, 0.06);
            --shadow-lg: 0 8px 32px rgba(60, 50, 40, 0.10);
            --radius: 12px;
            --radius-sm: 8px;
            --radius-xs: 6px;
            --transition: 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
            --font: 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Noto Sans SC', sans-serif;
            --sidebar-w: 350px;
        }
        * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
        body { font-family: var(--font); background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); min-height: 100vh; line-height: 1.6; overflow-x: hidden; }
        .header { padding: 20px 32px 16px; display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; }
        .header-left { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
        .header-line1 { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
        .logo { font-size: 30px; line-height: 1; }
        .brand-name { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text); letter-spacing: 0.5px; }
        .brand-tag { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text3); letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase; padding-left: 38px; }
        .sidebar-toggle { width: 42px; height: 42px; border-radius: var(--radius-xs); border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--card); cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 20px; transition: var(--transition); color: var(--text2); flex-shrink: 0; position: relative; z-index: 101; }
        .sidebar-toggle:hover { background: var(--bg2); border-color: var(--accent2); color: var(--accent3); }
        .sidebar-toggle.active { background: var(--accent-bg); border-color: var(--accent2); color: var(--accent3); }
        .history-dot { position: absolute; top: 6px; right: 6px; width: 8px; height: 8px; background: var(--accent); border-radius: 50%; display: none; }
        .history-dot.show { display: block; }
        .app-container { display: flex; min-height: calc(100vh - 90px); position: relative; }
        .main-content { flex: 1; padding: 8px 32px 40px; max-width: 820px; margin: 0 auto; width: 100%; }
        .sidebar-overlay { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(40, 35, 30, 0.25); z-index: 90; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity var(--transition); }
        .sidebar-overlay.open { opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; }
        .sidebar { position: fixed; top: 0; right: 0; width: var(--sidebar-w); height: 100vh; background: var(--card); border-left: 1px solid var(--border); z-index: 95; transform: translateX(100%); transition: transform var(--transition); display: flex; flex-direction: column; box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); }
        .sidebar.open { transform: translateX(0); }
        .sidebar-header { padding: 20px 20px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; flex-shrink: 0; }
        .sidebar-title { font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; color: var(--text); }
        .sidebar-count { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text3); background: var(--bg2); padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 10px; }
        .sidebar-list { flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; overflow-x: hidden; padding: 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; }
        .sidebar-empty { text-align: center; color: var(--text3); font-size: 13px; padding: 40px 20px; line-height: 1.8; }
        .sidebar-section-header { font-size: 12px; color: var(--accent3); padding: 10px 6px 6px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; user-select: none; letter-spacing: 0.5px; transition: var(--transition); flex-shrink: 0; }
        .sidebar-section-header:hover { color: var(--accent); }
        .sidebar-section-header .arrow { transition: transform 0.25s; font-size: 10px; color: var(--text3); }
        .sidebar-section-header.collapsed .arrow { transform: rotate(-90deg); }
        .sidebar-section-header::after { content: ''; flex: 1; height: 1px; background: var(--border-light); margin-left: 6px; }
        .sidebar-section-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; overflow: visible; transition: max-height 0.3s ease, opacity 0.25s; opacity: 1; }
        .sidebar-section-body.collapsed { max-height: 0; opacity: 0; overflow: hidden; }
        .sidebar-item { padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); border: 1px solid var(--border); cursor: pointer; transition: var(--transition); background: var(--card); flex-shrink: 0; }
        .sidebar-item:hover { border-color: var(--accent2); background: var(--accent-bg); }
        .sidebar-item.active { border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-bg); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--accent-light); }
        .sidebar-item-name { font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; color: var(--text); margin-bottom: 3px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
        .sidebar-item-name .rename-btn { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text3); cursor: pointer; margin-left: auto; padding: 2px 5px; line-height: 1; border-radius: 3px; transition: var(--transition); }
        .sidebar-item-name .rename-btn:hover { color: var(--accent3); background: var(--bg2); }
        .sidebar-item-meta { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text3); display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }
        .sidebar-item-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; display: inline-block; flex-shrink: 0; }
        .sidebar-item-actions { display: flex; gap: 4px; margin-top: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
        .sidebar-item-version { font-size: 10px; background: var(--accent-light); color: var(--accent3); padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 3px; font-weight: 500; }
        .btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 9px 18px; border-radius: var(--radius-xs); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid transparent; transition: var(--transition); font-family: var(--font); white-space: nowrap; user-select: none; justify-content: center; }
        .btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); }
        .btn-primary { background: var(--accent); color: #fff; border-color: var(--accent); }
        .btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent3); border-color: var(--accent3); }
        .btn-outline { background: transparent; border-color: var(--border); color: var(--text2); }
        .btn-outline:hover { background: var(--bg2); border-color: var(--accent2); color: var(--accent3); }
        .btn-ghost { background: transparent; border-color: transparent; color: var(--text2); padding: 8px 10px; }
        .btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--bg2); color: var(--text); }
        .btn-danger { background: var(--danger); color: #fff; border-color: var(--danger); }
        .btn-danger:hover { opacity: 0.85; }
        .btn-sm { padding: 5px 12px; font-size: 11px; border-radius: 4px; }
        .btn-xs { padding: 3px 8px; font-size: 10px; border-radius: 3px; }
        .btn-lg { padding: 11px 24px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; }
        .btn:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; pointer-events: none; }
        .api-config-card { background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 20px 24px; margin: 0 auto 20px; max-width: 600px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: center; }
        .api-config-card .field-group { flex: 1; min-width: 150px; max-width: 240px; }
        .api-config-card .btn { flex-shrink: 0; }
        .api-status { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 20px; white-space: nowrap; }
        .api-status.ok { background: var(--success-bg); color: var(--success); }
        .api-status.fail { background: var(--danger-bg); color: var(--danger); }
        .api-status.testing { background: #fef9e7; color: #b8a040; }
        .api-custom-row { display: none; width: 100%; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: flex-end; }
        .api-custom-row.show { display: flex; }
        .api-custom-row .field-group { flex: 1; min-width: 140px; }
        .backup-drawer { background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius); margin: 0 auto 20px; max-width: 600px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); overflow: hidden; }
        .backup-drawer-header { padding: 14px 24px; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; user-select: none; transition: var(--transition); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text2); }
        .backup-drawer-header:hover { background: var(--bg2); color: var(--text); }
        .backup-drawer-header .arrow { transition: transform 0.25s; font-size: 10px; color: var(--text3); }
        .backup-drawer-header.collapsed .arrow { transform: rotate(-90deg); }
        .backup-drawer-body { padding: 0 24px; overflow: hidden; transition: max-height 0.3s ease, padding 0.3s ease; max-height: 200px; }
        .backup-drawer-body.collapsed { max-height: 0; padding-top: 0; padding-bottom: 0; }
        .backup-drawer-inner { display: flex; gap: 10px; padding-bottom: 16px; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; }
        .freeform-card { background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 20px 24px; margin: 0 auto 28px; max-width: 600px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; min-height: 160px; }
        .freeform-card .ff-title { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text); letter-spacing: 0.5px; }
        .freeform-card .ff-textarea { flex: 1; width: 100%; min-height: 80px; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-xs); font-size: 13px; font-family: var(--font); background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); resize: vertical; line-height: 1.7; }
        .freeform-card .ff-textarea:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent2); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-light); }
        .freeform-card .ff-textarea::placeholder { color: var(--text3); font-style: italic; }
        .freeform-card .ff-footer { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; }
        .freeform-card .ff-hint { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text3); flex: 1; }
        .section { margin-bottom: 24px; }
        .section-title { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--accent3); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1.5px; margin-bottom: 14px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; transition: var(--transition); }
        .section-title::after { content: ''; flex: 1; height: 1px; background: var(--border); }
        .field-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(240px, 1fr)); gap: 14px; }
        .field-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; }
        .field-label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text2); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }
        .field-label .lock-icon { color: var(--danger); font-size: 10px; }
        .field-input, .field-select, .field-textarea { width: 100%; padding: 10px 13px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-xs); font-size: 13px; font-family: var(--font); background: var(--card); color: var(--text); transition: var(--transition); resize: vertical; }
        .field-input:focus, .field-select:focus, .field-textarea:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent2); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-light); }
        .field-textarea { min-height: 64px; }
        .field-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: flex-end; }
        .field-row .field-group { flex: 1; }
        .field-hint { font-size: 10px; color: var(--text3); font-style: italic; margin-top: 2px; }
        .dice-btn { width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--card); cursor: pointer; font-size: 15px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: var(--transition); flex-shrink: 0; color: var(--text3); line-height: 1; }
        .dice-btn:hover { background: var(--accent-bg); border-color: var(--accent2); color: var(--accent3); transform: rotate(30deg); }
        .dice-btn.spinning { animation: spin 0.5s ease-out; }
        .dice-btn.ai-dice { border-style: dashed; border-color: var(--accent-light); }
        .dice-btn.ai-dice:hover { background: #f0f6f9; border-color: var(--accent2); color: var(--accent3); }
        @keyframes spin { from { transform: rotate(0deg); } to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
        .dice-legend { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text3); margin-bottom: 10px; display: flex; gap: 16px; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; }
        .dice-legend span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }
        .dice-legend .legend-dot { width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; display: inline-block; border: 1.5px solid var(--border); background: var(--card); font-size: 9px; text-align: center; line-height: 12px; }
        .dice-legend .legend-dot.dashed { border-style: dashed; border-color: var(--accent-light); }
        .custom-fields { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
        .custom-field-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }
        .custom-field-row .field-input { flex: 1; }
        .custom-field-row .field-input:first-child { max-width: 140px; font-weight: 500; }
        .add-custom-btn { align-self: flex-start; margin-top: 4px; }
        .actions-bar { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; margin-top: 20px; padding-top: 20px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
        .result-area { margin-top: 32px; }
        .result-card { background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 28px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
        .result-card::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 3px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent2), var(--accent), var(--accent3)); }
        .result-header { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 20px; padding-bottom: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
        .result-avatar { width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 38px; flex-shrink: 0; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08); line-height: 1; }
        .result-name-area { flex: 1; }
        .result-name { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text); margin-bottom: 2px; }
        .result-subtitle { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text3); }
        .result-body { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.85; color: var(--text); }
        .result-body h3 { font-size: 15px; color: var(--accent3); margin: 18px 0 6px; font-weight: 600; }
        .result-body h4 { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text2); margin: 12px 0 4px; font-weight: 600; }
        .result-body p { margin-bottom: 8px; }
        .result-body ul { padding-left: 20px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
        .result-body li { margin-bottom: 4px; }
        .result-body .tag { display: inline-block; background: var(--accent-bg); color: var(--accent3); padding: 2px 9px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 12px; margin: 2px 4px 2px 0; }
        .result-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin-top: 20px; padding-top: 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); }
        .result-version-badge { font-size: 11px; background: var(--accent-light); color: var(--accent3); padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 12px; font-weight: 500; }
        .loading-overlay { display: none; position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(250, 247, 240, 0.75); z-index: 200; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; }
        .loading-overlay.show { display: flex; }
        .spinner { width: 40px; height: 40px; border: 3px solid var(--border); border-top-color: var(--accent); border-radius: 50%; animation: spin 0.8s linear infinite; }
        .loading-text { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text2); font-weight: 500; }
        .modal-overlay { display: none; position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(40, 35, 30, 0.4); z-index: 300; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
        .modal-overlay.show { display: flex; }
        .modal { background: var(--card); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 28px; max-width: 430px; width: 90%; box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); text-align: center; }
        .modal h3 { font-size: 16px; margin-bottom: 8px; color: var(--text); }
        .modal p { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text2); margin-bottom: 20px; line-height: 1.7; }
        .modal-actions { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; align-items: stretch; }
        .modal-actions-row { display: flex; gap: 10px; justify-content: center; }
        .draft-modal { background: var(--card); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 28px 32px; max-width: 480px; width: 90%; box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); animation: draftIn 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1); }
        @keyframes draftIn { from { transform: scale(0.92) translateY(20px); opacity: 0; } to { transform: scale(1) translateY(0); opacity: 1; } }
        .draft-modal h3 { font-size: 17px; color: var(--text); font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 6px; }
        .draft-modal .draft-sub { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text3); margin-bottom: 22px; font-style: italic; }
        .draft-options { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
        .draft-option { padding: 11px 14px; border: 1.5px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-xs); cursor: pointer; transition: var(--transition); background: var(--card); display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 2px; }
        .draft-option:hover { border-color: var(--accent2); background: var(--accent-bg); }
        .draft-option.selected { border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-bg); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--accent-light); }
        .draft-option-label { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text); }
        .draft-option-desc { font-size: 10px; color: var(--text3); }
        .draft-custom-input { display: none; margin-bottom: 14px; }
        .draft-custom-input.show { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }
        .draft-custom-input input { flex: 1; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-xs); font-size: 13px; }
        .draft-textarea { width: 100%; min-height: 90px; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-xs); font-size: 13px; font-family: var(--font); background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); resize: vertical; line-height: 1.7; margin-bottom: 16px; }
        .draft-textarea:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent2); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-light); }
        .draft-footer { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 8px; }
        .diary-modal { background: var(--paper); border-radius: 6px; max-width: 760px; width: 94%; max-height: 88vh; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 16px 50px rgba(60, 50, 40, 0.25), 0 4px 12px rgba(60, 50, 40, 0.15); display: flex; flex-direction: column; position: relative; animation: diaryIn 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.36, 0.64, 1); }
        @keyframes diaryIn { from { transform: scale(0.92) rotateY(8deg); opacity: 0; } to { transform: scale(1) rotateY(0); opacity: 1; } }
        .diary-modal::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 50px; width: 1px; background: rgba(196, 136, 123, 0.25); z-index: 1; }
        .diary-header { padding: 22px 50px 18px 80px; border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--paper-line); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(196, 136, 123, 0.04), transparent); position: relative; z-index: 2; }
        .diary-title { font-size: 22px; color: #6b4a3c; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.3; }
        .diary-date { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text3); }
        .diary-chapter-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-top: 6px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--text2); }
        .diary-chapter-nav .toc-btn { cursor: pointer; color: var(--accent3); font-weight: 600; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; }
        .diary-chapter-nav .toc-btn:hover { color: var(--accent); }
        .diary-body { padding: 28px 50px 28px 80px; overflow-y: auto; flex: 1; line-height: 30px; font-size: 15px; color: #4a3a2c; white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word; font-family: inherit; position: relative; z-index: 3; }
        .diary-body p { text-indent: 2em; margin-bottom: 0; }
        .diary-body strong { font-weight: 700; color: #2a2018; }
        .diary-body del { color: #b0a59a; text-decoration-color: #c4887b; opacity: 0.8; }
        .diary-body.editing { background: #fffef9; outline: 2px dashed var(--accent-light); outline-offset: -4px; cursor: text; }
        .diary-toolbar { padding: 12px 50px 12px 80px; border-top: 1px dashed var(--paper-line); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; background: rgba(196, 136, 123, 0.03); position: relative; z-index: 2; }
        .diary-toolbar-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
        .diary-close { position: absolute; top: 18px; right: 22px; width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid var(--paper-line); background: var(--paper); color: #6b4a3c; cursor: pointer; font-size: 14px; z-index: 5; transition: var(--transition); }
        .diary-close:hover { background: rgba(196, 136, 123, 0.15); transform: rotate(90deg); }
        .toc-overlay { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(40, 35, 30, 0.3); z-index: 350; display: none; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
        .toc-overlay.show { display: flex; }
        .toc-panel { background: var(--paper); border-radius: 6px; max-width: 400px; width: 90%; max-height: 70vh; overflow-y: auto; padding: 24px 30px; box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(60, 50, 40, 0.3); position: relative; }
        .toc-panel h3 { font-size: 18px; color: #6b4a3c; margin-bottom: 16px; text-align: center; font-weight: 700; }
        .toc-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 10px 0; border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--paper-line); cursor: pointer; transition: var(--transition); font-size: 14px; color: #4a3a2c; }
        .toc-item:hover { color: var(--accent3); background: rgba(123, 158, 174, 0.06); padding-left: 6px; }
        .toc-item .toc-num { font-weight: 700; color: var(--accent3); min-width: 40px; }
        .toc-item .toc-title { flex: 1; }
        .toc-item .toc-pages { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text3); }
        .toc-close { position: absolute; top: 12px; right: 16px; width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid var(--paper-line); background: var(--paper); color: #6b4a3c; cursor: pointer; font-size: 13px; transition: var(--transition); }
        .toc-close:hover { background: rgba(196, 136, 123, 0.15); }
        .inner-voice-modal { background: #fdf8f0; border-radius: 20px; max-width: 420px; width: 90%; box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(60, 40, 30, 0.35), 0 4px 16px rgba(60, 40, 30, 0.15); position: relative; padding: 32px 28px 24px; animation: voiceIn 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.36, 0.64, 1); overflow: visible; }
        @keyframes voiceIn { from { transform: scale(0.85) translateY(30px); opacity: 0; } to { transform: scale(1) translateY(0); opacity: 1; } }
        .voice-emoji-deco { position: absolute; font-size: 18px; pointer-events: none; user-select: none; }
        .voice-emoji-deco.d1 { top: -14px; left: 18px; }
        .voice-emoji-deco.d2 { top: -10px; right: 22px; }
        .voice-emoji-deco.d3 { bottom: -12px; left: 30px; }
        .voice-emoji-deco.d4 { bottom: -8px; right: 16px; }
        .voice-emoji-deco.d5 { top: 40%; left: -16px; }
        .voice-emoji-deco.d6 { top: 35%; right: -14px; }
        .voice-title-box { background: #fdf3e4; border: 2px solid #e0c8a8; border-radius: 10px 10px 0 0; padding: 10px 20px; text-align: center; margin: -44px auto 16px; max-width: 200px; position: relative; z-index: 2; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); }
        .voice-title-box span { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: #6b4a3c; letter-spacing: 1px; }
        .voice-body { text-align: center; padding: 8px 16px; line-height: 2; font-size: 15px; color: #4a3020; max-width: 240px; margin: 0 auto; word-break: keep-all; }
        .voice-body.editing { background: #fffef9; outline: 2px dashed var(--accent-light); outline-offset: -4px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: text; }
        .voice-unsaid { text-align: center; margin-top: 10px; font-style: italic; font-size: 12px; color: #9a8070; padding: 0 20px; }
        .voice-unsaid::before { content: '"'; }
        .voice-unsaid::after { content: '"'; }
        .voice-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; justify-content: flex-end; margin-top: 18px; padding-top: 12px; border-top: 1px dashed #e0d0c0; }
        .voice-close-btn { position: absolute; top: 10px; right: 14px; width: 26px; height: 26px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid #e0d0c0; background: #fdf8f0; color: #8a7060; cursor: pointer; font-size: 12px; transition: var(--transition); z-index: 5; }
        .voice-close-btn:hover { background: rgba(196, 136, 123, 0.15); transform: rotate(90deg); }
        .toast-container { position: fixed; bottom: 24px; right: 24px; z-index: 400; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
        .toast { padding: 10px 14px 10px 18px; border-radius: var(--radius-xs); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: #fff; animation: slideIn 0.3s ease-out; box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); max-width: 380px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
        .toast.success { background: var(--success); }
        .toast.error { background: var(--danger); }
        .toast.info { background: var(--accent3); }
        .toast-msg { flex: 1; line-height: 1.4; }
        .toast-close { width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 50%; border: none; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25); color: #fff; cursor: pointer; font-size: 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; line-height: 1; }
        .toast-close:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4); }
        .user-section-container { position: relative; }
        .user-section-body { overflow: hidden; transition: max-height 0.3s ease, opacity 0.25s; max-height: 2000px; opacity: 1; position: relative; padding-left: 14px; border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-light); margin-bottom: 24px; }
        .user-section-body.collapsed { max-height: 0; opacity: 0; padding-top: 0; padding-bottom: 0; margin-bottom: 0; border-color: transparent; }
        .user-disabled-overlay { position: absolute; inset: -10px; z-index: 10; cursor: not-allowed; background: rgba(253, 251, 246, 0.5); backdrop-filter: blur(1.5px); border-radius: 8px; display: none; }
        .user-disabled-overlay.show { display: block; }
        .user-section-title { cursor: pointer; user-select: none; }
        .user-section-title:hover { color: var(--accent); }
        .user-section-title .arrow { transition: transform 0.25s; display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; margin-left: auto; color: var(--text3); }
        .user-section-title.collapsed .arrow { transform: rotate(-90deg); }
        .active-profile-badge { font-size: 10px; background: var(--success-bg); color: var(--success); padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 12px; font-weight: normal; margin-left: 10px; letter-spacing: 0; display: none; }
        @keyframes slideIn { from { transform: translateX(100%); opacity: 0; } to { transform: translateX(0); opacity: 1; } }
        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .main-content { padding: 12px 14px 32px; }
            .field-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
            .api-config-card, .freeform-card, .backup-drawer { flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; max-width: 100%; }
            .api-config-card .field-group { max-width: none; }
            .sidebar { width: 100%; max-width: 360px; }
            .result-card { padding: 16px; }
            .result-header { flex-direction: column; align-items: center; text-align: center; }

            .brand-name { font-size: 18px; }
            .brand-tag { font-size: 10px; padding-left: 30px; }

            .diary-body, .diary-header, .diary-toolbar { padding-left: 50px; padding-right: 20px; }
            .diary-modal::before { left: 30px; }
            .inner-voice-modal { padding: 24px 16px 18px; }
            .voice-body { max-width: 200px; font-size: 14px; }
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 5px; }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: transparent; }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--border); border-radius: 10px; }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: var(--text3); }
        .nsfw-badge { display: inline-block; background: #fce4e4; color: #c4887b; font-size: 9px; padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 3px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.5px; vertical-align: middle; margin-left: 4px; }
        .draft-icon-btn { background: var(--accent-light); color: var(--accent3); border: 1px solid var(--accent-light); font-family: serif; }

<body>

    <header class="header">
        <div class="header-left">
            <div class="header-line1"><span class="logo">☁️</span><span class="brand-name">Claudia 角色生成器</span></div>
            <span class="brand-tag">AI-Powered Character Creator</span>
        </div>
        <button class="sidebar-toggle" id="sidebarToggle" onclick="toggleSidebar()" title="历史记录及预设">☰<span class="history-dot" id="historyDot"></span></button>
    </header>

    <div class="sidebar-overlay" id="sidebarOverlay" onclick="toggleSidebar()"></div>
    <aside class="sidebar" id="sidebar">
        <div class="sidebar-header"><span class="sidebar-title">📋 历史记录与预设</span><span class="sidebar-count" id="sidebarCount">0</span></div>
        <div class="sidebar-list" id="sidebarList"></div>
    </aside>

    <div class="app-container">
        <main class="main-content" id="mainContent">

            <div class="api-config-card">
                <div class="field-group"><label class="field-label">🔌 API 提供商</label><select class="field-select" id="apiProvider" onchange="onProviderChange()"><option value="deepseek">DeepSeek</option><option value="siliconflow">硅基流动 (SiliconFlow)</option><option value="kimi">Kimi (Moonshot)</option><option value="custom">自定义...</option></select></div>
                <div class="field-group"><label class="field-label">🔑 API Key</label><input type="password" class="field-input" id="apiKey" placeholder="sk-..." onchange="onFieldChange()"></div>
                <div class="field-group" id="modelSelectGroup"><label class="field-label">🤖 模型选择</label><select class="field-select" id="modelSelect" onchange="onModelChange()"><option value="deepseek-v4-flash">deepseek-v4-flash</option><option value="deepseek-v4-pro">deepseek-v4-pro</option><option value="__custom__">自定义模型...</option></select></div>
                <div class="field-group" id="customModelGroup" style="display:none;"><label class="field-label">自定义模型名</label><input type="text" class="field-input" id="customModel" placeholder="输入模型名..." onchange="onFieldChange()"></div>
                <div class="api-custom-row" id="apiCustomRow">
                    <div class="field-group"><label class="field-label">🔗 API 链接</label><input type="text" class="field-input" id="customEndpoint" placeholder="https://api.example.com/v1/chat/completions" onchange="onFieldChange()"></div>
                    <div class="field-group"><label class="field-label">🤖 自定义模型</label><input type="text" class="field-input" id="customModelName" placeholder="输入模型名..." onchange="onFieldChange()"></div>
                </div>
                <button class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" onclick="testConnection()" id="testBtn">🔗 测试连接</button>
                <span class="api-status" id="apiStatus" style="display:none;"></span>
            </div>

            <div class="backup-drawer">
                <div class="backup-drawer-header collapsed" id="backupDrawerHeader" onclick="toggleBackupDrawer()"><span class="arrow">▼</span> 💾 导入/导出备份</div>
                <div class="backup-drawer-body collapsed" id="backupDrawerBody"><div class="backup-drawer-inner"><button class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" onclick="exportBackup()">📥 导出备份</button><button class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" onclick="document.getElementById('importFileInput').click()">📤 导入备份</button><input type="file" id="importFileInput" accept=".json" style="display:none;" onchange="importBackup(event)"><span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);">备份包含角色、试阅、用户预设等全部数据</span></div></div>
            </div>

            <div class="freeform-card">
                <div class="ff-title">📝 填写需求，AI 根据模板生成具体人设</div>
                <textarea class="ff-textarea" id="freeformRequirement" placeholder="在这里用自然语言描述你想要的角色……

例如：我想要一个赛博朋克世界的女性黑客，性格冷酷但内心柔软，有一头紫色短发，擅长潜入企业数据库……

你填得越详细，AI 生成的角色就越贴合你的想象。留空则完全由 AI 自由发挥。"></textarea>
                <div class="ff-footer"><span class="ff-hint">💡 你填的所有内容都会被 AI 润色扩展，简短的描述会自动扩充为详细设定</span><button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="generateFromFreeform()">开始生成</button></div>
            </div>

            <div class="user-section-container">
                <div class="section-title user-section-title" id="userSectionTitle" onclick="toggleMainUserSection()">👤 用户设定 <span style="font-weight:400;color:var(--text3);font-size:11px;margin-left:6px;text-transform:none;">（不填则 AI 不会提及用户）</span><span class="active-profile-badge" id="activeProfileBadge">已启用预设</span><span class="arrow">▼</span></div>
                <div class="user-section-body" id="mainUserSectionBody">
                    <div class="user-disabled-overlay" id="userDisabledOverlay" onclick="showUserDisabledAlert()"></div>
                    <div class="field-grid">
                        <div class="field-group"><label class="field-label">用户名字</label><input type="text" class="field-input" id="userName" placeholder="不填则 AI 不提及用户名" onchange="onFieldChange()"></div>
                        <div class="field-group"><label class="field-label">用户性别</label><select class="field-select" id="userGender" onchange="onUserGenderChange();onFieldChange();"><option value="">不填（模糊化）</option><option value="男">男</option><option value="女">女</option><option value="双性">双性</option><option value="扶她">扶她</option><option value="__custom__">自定义...</option></select></div>
                        <div class="field-group" id="userCustomGenderGroup" style="display:none;"><label class="field-label">自定义用户性别</label><input type="text" class="field-input" id="userCustomGender" placeholder="输入性别..." onchange="onFieldChange()"></div>
                        <div class="field-group"><label class="field-label">用户身份</label><input type="text" class="field-input" id="userIdentity" placeholder="如：主人、旅伴、同事... 不填则不提及" onchange="onFieldChange()"></div>
                        <div class="field-group" style="grid-column: 1 / -1;"><label class="field-label">用户外貌</label><textarea class="field-textarea" id="userAppearance" placeholder="不填则 AI 不描述用户外貌" onchange="onFieldChange()" rows="2"></textarea></div>
                        <div class="field-group"><label class="field-label">用户自选左右位</label><select class="field-select" id="userPosition" onchange="onUserPositionChange();onFieldChange();"><option value="">不填（不提及）</option><option value="左位">左位（攻/主动方）</option><option value="右位">右位（受/被动方）</option><option value="不限">不限</option></select></div>
                        <div class="field-group"><label class="field-label">其它（自定义）</label><input type="text" class="field-input" id="userOther" placeholder="任何关于用户的补充信息..." onchange="onFieldChange()"></div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="section"><div class="section-title">📝 角色基础信息</div><div class="dice-legend"><span><span class="legend-dot">🎲</span> 实线 = 本地随机库</span><span><span class="legend-dot dashed">🎲</span> 虚线 = AI 智能生成</span><span style="color:var(--text3);">| 无 🎲 = 请在下方填写或留空由 AI 在生成时补全</span></div><div class="field-grid">
                <div class="field-group"><label class="field-label">角色名（中文）</label><div class="field-row"><input type="text" class="field-input" id="charName" placeholder="留空则 AI 随机生成" onchange="onFieldChange()"><button class="dice-btn ai-dice" onclick="AI.randomName()" title="AI 随机生成名字">🎲</button></div></div>
                <div class="field-group"><label class="field-label">所处国家类型</label><select class="field-select" id="countryType" onchange="toggleCountryFields();onFieldChange();"><option value="real">现实国家</option><option value="virtual">虚拟国家</option></select></div>
                <div class="field-group" id="realCountryGroup"><label class="field-label">所处国家</label><input type="text" class="field-input" id="countryName" placeholder="如：中国、日本、法国..." onchange="onFieldChange()"></div>
                <div class="field-group" id="virtualCountryGroup" style="display:none;"><label class="field-label">虚拟国家名</label><input type="text" class="field-input" id="virtualCountryName" placeholder="如：艾泽拉斯王国..." onchange="onFieldChange()"></div>
                <div class="field-group" id="realRefGroup" style="display:none;"><label class="field-label">对应现实国家（可选）</label><input type="text" class="field-input" id="realRefCountry" placeholder="留空则无对应" onchange="onFieldChange()"></div>
                <div class="field-group"><label class="field-label">角色语言</label><input type="text" class="field-input" id="charLanguage" placeholder="如：中文、日语、精灵语..." onchange="onFieldChange()"></div>
                <div class="field-group"><label class="field-label">居住地</label><input type="text" class="field-input" id="residence" placeholder="如：城市名、具体地址、住处描述..." onchange="onFieldChange()"></div>
            </div></div>

            <div class="section"><div class="section-title">🌍 世界观与身份</div><div class="field-grid">
                <div class="field-group"><label class="field-label">世界观</label><select class="field-select" id="worldview" onchange="onWorldviewChange();onFieldChange();"><option value="现代架空（无特殊设定）">现代架空（无特殊设定）</option><option value="现代多种族">现代多种族</option><option value="中世纪奇幻">中世纪奇幻</option><option value="赛博朋克">赛博朋克</option><option value="未来世界">未来世界</option><option value="古代">古代</option><option value="古代武侠">古代武侠</option><option value="修仙">修仙</option><option value="西幻">西幻</option><option value="__custom__">自定义世界观...</option></select></div>
                <div class="field-group" id="customWorldviewGroup" style="display:none;"><label class="field-label">自定义世界观</label><input type="text" class="field-input" id="customWorldview" placeholder="输入你的世界观..." onchange="onFieldChange()"></div>
                <div class="field-group"><label class="field-label">种族</label><input type="text" class="field-input" id="race" placeholder="如：人类、精灵、AI仿生人..." onchange="onFieldChange()"></div>

                <div class="field-group" id="customGenderGroup" style="display:none;"><label class="field-label">自定义性别</label><input type="text" class="field-input" id="customGender" placeholder="输入性别..." onchange="onFieldChange()"></div>
